audit.whatIsWrong: Row 1 is marked Tahm Kench while whys[1] says 'Level 2 stays even before his stun and sustain tools are online'.
audit.why: Thick Skin and the three-stack stun are not online at 2; the packet chart reads Skill / Skill / Tahm Kench / Skill / Skill / Tahm Kench / Tahm Kench, which fits a 49.42% lane over 1034 games.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill in both layers; the rest of the chart already matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers anywhere, and the page tells the player to trade 'when Thick Skin is spent' — advice that cannot be followed because Thick Skin is on a 3-second cooldown.
audit.why: Tongue Lash is 7s at rank 1, Abyssal Dive 21s (his only knockup and his reposition — by far the longest gap in his kit), Thick Skin 3s, and Devour has no listed cooldown, only a 100 mana cost. Zaahen's Q and E are 10s at rank 1, W 14s, R 110s.
audit.corrected: Point the whole page at Abyssal Dive's 21s as the real window, and replace 'wait for Thick Skin' with Grievous Wounds, which is the only thing that actually blunts it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tahm Kench's slots are scrambled across the content layer: Thick Skin is written as (W) when it is E, Devour as (W) when it is R, and Abyssal Dive as (R) when it is W. The stun is also described as a 'three-hit Tongue Lash' — the stun fires when the target carries three An Acquired Taste stacks, which build from any damage he deals, not from three Q hits. Zaahen's E is called 'Golden Onslaught' rather than Aureate Rush.
audit.why: Riot's text: Tongue Lash 'Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks... they are stunned.' Thick Skin: 'Passive: stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.' The missing-interaction file flags needs-antiheal on both Tongue Lash and Thick Skin — Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended trade, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Fix all three slot letters, describe the stun as a stack count you can break off from at two, and make Grievous Wounds the stated answer to Thick Skin rather than waiting for a cooldown that is always up.

edits.before: Level 3 tips to Tahm Kench: with Tongue Lash (Q) stun setup and passive Grey Health he can eat your best trade and heal it back with Thick Skin (W), so don't dump your Golden Onslaught (E) cooldown into a full-health Kench. Bait his Q slow/stun before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 3 tips to Tahm Kench: Tongue Lash (Q, 7s) heals him on every hit and stuns once you carry three An Acquired Taste stacks, so break off at two. Thick Skin (E) turns stored damage into a shield every 3s — Grievous Wounds is the answer, not waiting it out.

edits.before: Kench's 6 gives him Abyssal Dive (R) roam and Devour (W) plays, but the lane duel is close — your Final Retribution (R) plus Q knock-up can still burst him if you catch him mid-Grey-Health. Just respect that his W can eat an ally to save a gank or reposition.
edits.after: Kench's 6 gives him Devour (R), which eats an ally out of your combo or chews you for magic damage — but the lane duel stays close. Abyssal Dive (W, 21s) is his knockup and his reposition; sidestep it and your Glaive recast plus Grim Deliverance still burst him.

edits.before: Tahm Kench spikes: his Thick Skin (W) converts your poke into a shield and he out-sustains your Darkin Glaive (Q) trades, so grinding him down in lane rarely works. Chunk him only when his Grey Health is already spent, or you're just feeding his passive.
edits.after: Tahm Kench spikes: Thick Skin (E) converts your poke into a shield every 3s and he out-sustains The Darkin Glaive (Q) trades, so grinding him down without Grievous Wounds never works. Commit in one window instead of chipping — chip is what feeds him.

edits.before: Kench stays favoured — he's a near-unkillable brick who Q-stuns you, Devours (W) his carries out of your Final Retribution (R), and shields through your damage. Don't try to solo him; force objectives and punish his teammates when his W is on cooldown.

notes: Worst slot damage in the slice: three of Tahm Kench's four abilities were on the wrong letter throughout the content layer (Thick Skin as W, Devour as W, Abyssal Dive as R). Also a piece of unfollowable advice repeated across four fields — 'trade when Thick Skin is spent', when Thick Skin has a 3-second cooldown. Replaced with Grievous Wounds, which the missing-interaction file flags as the real answer, and pointed the timing advice at Abyssal Dive's 21s instead. Stun corrected from 'three-hit Q' to three An Acquired Taste stacks.
